title: Captain Jack's Kiawah Sailing and Dolphin Watching

services.name: Dolphin Watching
services.desc: Private Island Picnic Shelling Adventure: Probably our most popular sailing charter. It is specifically tailored to the charter guest personal interest. Great for families with kids, adult groups or corporate outings. Captain jack will tow a small inflatable rubber boat (dingy) behind the sailing yacht PALMETTO TIDE as you sail to a remote pristine barrier island. Upon arrival we drop anchor and dingy ashore to visit the best beach in South Carolina. This is a great spot to completely get away from it all. services.name: Family Fishing
services.desc: INSHORE KID CREEK FISHING A half or full day of bottom fishing with your children. We often catch small grunts, croakers, whiting, flounder, or spot tail bass. The young anglers think this trip is a blast and their parents seem to get a chuckle out of it as well. DON'T FORGET TO BRING YOUR CAMERA!!! If you like, Captain Jack will give an informal sailing lesson and let the little swabs steer the boat on the sail home. As always dolphin abound.
